title: Session index: thousands of sessions held in memory, one query, no database

chat.text: The node-side query the Sessions page already uses grows into one SessionIndex class: every session, task, landing line and cost loaded once, kept fresh by watching the store, answered by plain JavaScript filters from the browser and the scripts. Tasks get tagged by the modules they touched so "everything that touched Dictate" is one query. Load time and heap are measured.
